reviews.text:
The product is great, a really mild concentration of the retinol. I'm new to using retinoids and was scared of having a bad reaction. I've been using this every other day and have seen results with minimal purging (honestly not more than the pimples I'd get during Summer). I have textured, uneven skin due to closed comedomes and acne scarring. The comedomes are calming down and my acne scars have lightened.
Obviously my skin will be different from others so still do a patch test and be careful etc.
The packaging is a bit annoying, it's difficult to remove the inner cover without making a mess.
reviews.zh:
呢款產品好好，視黃醇（retinol）濃度好温和。我係第一次用類視黃醇，好驚會有不良反應。我隔日用一次，見到效果，而且爆痘（purging）好少（老實講，唔會比夏天時嗰啲暗瘡多）。我嘅皮膚因為閉口同暗瘡疤痕，紋理唔平均。閉口都平伏咗，我嘅暗瘡疤痕都淡咗。
當然，每個人嘅皮膚都唔同，所以仍然要先做敏感測試，留心啲等等。
包裝有少少煩，內蓋好難拆，容易整得一塌糊塗。

reviews.text: I'm looking for a korean skin care with Retinol since it is popular now and I saw a drastic changes to other people (but it doesn't mean it will also work for me) but I'm willing to take a risk. I have oily and visible pores and lots of black and white heads on my nose that I really want to get rid of. I also have one line under my eye hoping it will reduce. I bought ceramide cream or the Illiyoon which I plan to put forst before this retinol cream and I saw it has a good percentage of retinol for first timer. Hopinng this one will work and love the packaging
reviews.zh: 我而家好想搵一款有視黃醇嘅韓國護膚品，因為而家好流行，我見過其他人有好大改變（但唔代表對我都一樣有效），不過我願意冒險一試。我嘅皮膚係油性，鼻頭毛孔好明顯，仲有好多黑頭同白頭，我好想除走佢哋。眼下面都有一條幼紋，希望會減少。我買咗 Illiyoon 嘅神經酰胺面霜，計劃喺呢款視黃醇霜之前先塗，我見到呢款對初用者嚟講視黃醇比例都幾好。希望呢款有效，我又好鍾意個包裝。

reviews.text: I purchased this in march and since then I have only used couple of times on face as well as on my hands because I have ugly wrinkles on my knuckles. I have very light wrinkles on my forehead so I wanted to get rid of that. also I have a neckline which is quite irritating. I got the best result on my fingers as the wrinkles have shrunken and since I have very little wrinkles on my forehead, it's still very little. it helps get rid of smile line as well. over all I am very impressed with this product. I have had searched a lot to find something that would work and I am glad I found this. it's really creamy and since I have oily skin so I don't need much to put on. we don't have to use it everyday. once a week or maybe 2 is good enough. the only downside is that it dries out your skin. like I said I have oily skin and it dried my skin so I had painfully dry and rough skin for sometimes before I got back my sebum production back. so use a good moisturizer and use this product only at night ,I guess I don't need to say that but who knows if someone needed to be told. good luck. I am attaching my hand pictures to show the difference.
reviews.zh: 我今年三月買咗呢款，之後只係用過幾次，喺面同手上都有用，因為我個指關節有啲難睇嘅皺紋。我額頭有好淺嘅皺紋，所以想除走。另外我頸紋都好煩人，好刺激。我最好嘅效果喺手指上，因為指關節嘅皺紋已經縮咗；而額頭嘅皺紋好少，所以仍然好少。佢都有助淡化笑紋。總括嚟講，我好滿意呢款產品。我搵咗好多嘢想搵返啲有效嘅產品，好高興搵到呢款。佢質地好綿密，我皮膚油，所以唔需要用好多。唔使每日都用，每個星期一次或者兩次就夠。唯一缺點係會令皮膚乾燥。我講過我皮膚油，但佢令我皮膚好乾，有段時間皮膚痛楚咁乾同粗糙，直至我嘅皮脂分泌返正常。所以要用好啲嘅保濕霜，而且只喺晚上用呢款產品。我諗呢句唔使講，但係話唔定有人需要聽。祝你好運。我附上咗我隻手嘅相，俾你睇吓分別。

reviews.text:
This is my first time trying out a retinol based product and I honestly was blown away the impact its had on my skin. It has somewhat of a thick consistency, so use sparingly. It irritated my skin upon first use, making my smile lines very itchy though it left no visible marks behind. As I kept on using it, applying as the very last step of my nightly skincare routine, my skin grew used it. It visibly tightened my pores upon first use, and I can see how with extended use, it would tighten the skin to a certain degree. It also help me get rid of the suborn white itchy spots I would always get on my neck and jawline. This makes for a great first time introduction to retinol based products, highly recommend. Would buy again. 
Also the tiniest bit goes a VERY VERY long way.
reviews.zh:
呢個係我第一次試視黃醇類產品，老實講對我皮膚嘅影響真係令我好驚訝。質地有啲厚，所以要慳用。第一次用嗰陣令我皮膚有啲刺激，笑紋位置好痕，但係冇留低任何明顯痕跡。我繼續用，每晚將佢做護膚最後一步，皮膚慢慢適應咗。第一次用已經見到毛孔即時收緊，我可以睇到如果長期用，皮膚都會收緊到某個程度。佢仲幫我除走咗我頸同下巴經常長嘅頑固白色痕癢斑點。對第一次接觸視黃醇類產品嘅人嚟講，係好好嘅入門產品，極力推薦。會再買。
而且只需要一丁點，就可以用好耐。

reviews.text: This is hands down, the most effective cream I have ever used. The consistency is quite unusual, it's very sticky when you first apply it, but after a minute your face feels super soft. It has a light scent to it, that's the only disadvantage. My skin is acne prone and sensitive. The cream has not caused any discomfort or extra redness. Have been using this for two weeks and my extremely textured skin seems so much smoother. It looks bouncier and younger. This is a nightcream, so I only apply it at night. I highly suggest you to buy this product, it's truly a miracle worker.
reviews.zh: 毫無疑問，呢款係我用過最有效嘅面霜。質地好特別，塗嗰陣好黏，但係一分鐘之後面就會超級軟滑。佢有淡淡嘅香味，呢個係唯一嘅缺點。我嘅皮膚易生暗瘡同敏感。呢款面霜冇令我不適，亦冇令我皮膚多咗紅。用咗兩個星期，我本來紋理好粗糙嘅皮膚睇落順滑咗好多。睇落更有彈性、更年輕。呢款係晚霜，所以我只喺晚上塗。我強烈推薦你買呢款產品，佢真係好神奇。

reviews.text: This cream is absolutely, without a doubt, the strangest consistency I've ever used. If you can get past the unusual texture, you might really enjoy this. I feel like this does an excellent job with firming and smoothing. This helps my forehead crease look less intense. I like this best on my neck, I really feel like this helps tighten up the neck, as I've lost some weight and it feels kind of flabby, the nights I use this it feels more firm.
reviews.zh: 呢款面霜毫無疑問係我用過最奇怪嘅質地。如果你可以接受咁特別嘅質地，你可能真係會好鍾意。我覺得佢喺緊緻同撫平方面做得好好。佢幫我額頭嘅紋睇落冇咁明顯。我最鍾意喺頸上用，我真係覺得佢幫頸位收緊，因為我最近瘦咗，頸位好似有啲鬆鬆哋，用佢嗰晚就覺得緊緻咗。

reviews.text:
At first I wasn’t too sure about the texture of this cream. The consistency is very gluey and sticky. But, after I applied onto the skin, it melts and absord nicely. I’m in my 40’s and have oily combination skin. I use this cream at night time before bed, and in the morning my skin is glowing. And now I am looking to buy the third jar. The packaging is cute, it has vanilla scent, not too over powering. 
It’s an excellent aging cream :)
reviews.zh:
一開始我唔係好肯定呢款面霜嘅質地。佢好似膠水咁黏。但係塗到皮膚上之後就化開、吸收得好好。我四十幾歲，係油性混合皮膚。我晚上睡前用呢款面霜，早上起身皮膚都有光澤。而家我考慮再買第三罐。個包裝好可愛，有香草味，唔會太濃。
係一款好好嘅抗老化面霜 :)

reviews.text:
I've calculated the % retinol in the product and found it to be 0.075%. So it's a good strength for beginners for sure, and I'm phasing it in every 2nd or 3rd day. 

I tried it on my husband's fine lines across his forehead last night, AND IT'S HONESTLY VISIBLY BETTER. I'd say around 70% improvement with the fine wrinkles, after ONE use. I'm very impressed so far. 

From the studies I've read, I'm sure we'll see even more improvements with continued use. Very pleased with this purchase, and very likely to buy one for my husband too. Remember to moisturise!!
reviews.zh:
我計過呢款產品嘅視黃醇百分比，係 0.075%。所以對初學者嚟講肯定係好啱嘅濃度，我每隔兩三日先慢慢加入使用。

我尋晚喺老公額頭嘅細紋上試咗，而且老實講，真係睇得出好咗。我會話用一次之後，細紋大約改善咗七成。我而家都好欣賞。

睇過嘅研究，我相信持續用，會有更多改善。我好滿意呢次購買，好有可能都會買一罐畀我老公。記住要保濕！！

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
